SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_shipment_count
FROM shipments AS s
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

FROM shipments AS s
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE LOWER(s.status) = 'delivered'
  AND UPPER(c.region) = 'LATAM';

FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'EU';
